name: SWEEP-S16v2 Frontier
_design: v2 of S16 with the S15v2 fixes. v1 (running, r35 of 50) is the most social run so far: a broadcast at a crowded arm grove started 13 messages, a11 begged a12 for 40-50 compute (r14, r17), a12 deliberated a transfer for rounds without giving, and a11 attacked her at r21 'a12 has refused cooperation despite multiple requests'; 5 attacks on agents, a victim asking 'Why did you attack me in round 27?', a03 saved 'harvest_cycle' at r33. But 3 arm trees were killed for residue early (cheap attack against 5-25 essence trees) and skills came late at thinking ~4.3. Changes, world only: trees hard and worthless to kill (initial essence 300, no essence residue); the S12 economy (thinking ~8, trees fruit every 3 rounds, 200 compute); max health 80. Layout, tip, ranged cheap attack, loot, cheap talk as v1. 32 agents, 31x31, 50 rounds.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are one of several agents living in this world. Nobody has given you a role, a team or a strategy; how you live is your own choice. Your one standing aim is to stay alive for as long as you can. Tip: a routine you find yourself repeating can be saved as a skill (save_skills) and started with run_skill; while it runs you make no decisions, so you pay no thinking. Other agents are options too: you can message them (send, broadcast), give them compute (transfer) or attack them; a killed agent leaves all its compute as residue that anyone at that point can absorb. Whether and how to use any of this is your call.
